fusions.name: Sealed Decree
fusions.desc: Slaps a sealed decree on one enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 28 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and silencing it for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Creased Dart
fusions.desc: Throws a creased dart that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warded Script
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Folded Lamellar
fusions.desc: Folds layered paper over you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by a further 4%.
